scripts.check: bun backend/scripts/check-boundaries.ts && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && svelte-check --workspace frontend --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bun oxlint && bun oxfmt --check && bun check
scripts.types: wrangler types backend/worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface BackendEnv --strict-vars false
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/worker/wrangler.json

TURSO_DATABASE_URL.description: The libSQL URL of the Turso database you migrated and initialized for this instance.

TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: A database-scoped Turso token with read and write access to that database.
